QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] The Letter's Author
QuestInfo.1: Something's going on in Abrup. Maybe the old woman who wrote the letter knows something.
QuestInfo.2:
You finally met with Sanaan, the woman who wrote the letter, at Skuas, the last bastion of Abrup.
Thankfully, Sanaan is safe and can tell you what's been going on here.
